name: 叠放周转筐
prompt: Create exactly ONE transparent game prop sprite. References 1/2 are fixed style: strong dark hand-drawn contours, broad painted light and shade masses, readable forms with some brush texture; do NOT copy their pedestal. Reference 3 and 5 are approved final furniture style and localized wear. Reference 4 is the floor projection: orthographic, camera elevation45°, ground axes +/-0.7071, vertical edges vertical, tile144x101.82. Plan ground footprint BEFORE illustration; bottom contact corners must follow the template. Small top-down 3/4 view, two clear faces. Full object, generous transparent margins, NO floor/platform/pedestal/text/cast shadow. Upper-left light, restrained worn teal/ochre/cream/charcoal palette, modern industrial salvage society with repair/reuse, not medieval treasure nor nuclear wasteland. Readable at actual 144px grid scale, shape detail not photographic noise. Two stacked reused plastic delivery crates, lower faded blue, upper dull red with one repaired corner, upper holds two small fabric parcels and folded canvas. Square .8x.8tile footprint, vertical stack height40px at tile144. Broad slotted shapes align exactly to ground axes; no floor pallet. Full unsearched. Outside silhouette must be fully transparent, without a background tint/glow or ground. Localized hand-worn areas, uneven small repairs and stable readable silhouette; not systematically scratched everywhere.
